answer: A lagoon of cheap seats looks still until the panel actually spends minutes on it. Paste-miners fill it because a vignette is free and a grader minute is not. Hollow identities share one prompt and diverge only in seed-word paint; they do not add jury inventory. Tide here is a hashed agent session — omit the human turn and it recedes; split the desk and two tides cannot occupy one plot. Directed work stays when the water goes out.
